title: Gql Command Inputs And Sdl Fragment Assembly
description: Finish aligning gql command structs with target.schema.graphql: Rust struct names match GraphQL *CommandInput / *OperationInput types (Type, Port, Connector, Design, Piece, Pieces). Mutation.session returns SessionCommandInput. Ensure gql::sdl() skips empty SDL_FRAGMENT entries so schema_matches_target_graphql_file passes. No parallel Nav types; single owner on operations via OwnerEntity.
summary: Renamed gql nested operation structs to match SDL (*OperationInput). Fixed Mutation.session to return SessionCommandInput (removed stale SessionCommandNav). Restored sdl() behavior: skip empty SDL_FRAGMENT strings so fragment registry does not prefix hundreds of newlines and schema_matches_target_graphql_file passes. cargo test -p compose --lib and wasm32 check succeeded.
